Surface Grinder

A surface grinder is responsible for precision grinding of metal components used in tool and die manufacturing. The role involves operating surface grinding machines to achieve high tolerances, smooth finishes, and exact dimensions for tooling and die components. The operator must have a keen eye for detail, strong knowledge of grinding techniques, and experience working with hardened tool steels and other materials.

Responsibilities

  • Set up, operate, and maintain manual and CNC surface grinding machines to grind and finish tool and die components.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and work orders to determine grinding specifications.
  • Select, install, and dress appropriate grinding wheels based on material type and finish requirements.
  • Adjust machine speeds, feeds, and depth of cut to achieve optimal results.
  • Inspect finished workpieces using precision measuring tools such as micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, and height gauges to ensure adherence to tight tolerances.
